llm_input:
Synopsis:
Aradin comes across the corpses of some of his friends, who were lost during the goblin raid. He's in a neutral location at a bridge and observing the corpses of his people and of goblins, who were also killed in the fight.

Cluster Contexts:
- DEN_AdventurersQuest_LeaderAtCorpses.json: Aradin has come upon the bodies of friends lost in a goblin raid and is standing on a neutral bridge among the corpses of both his people and the goblins that fell in the fight. The brooding sovereign — a displaced myconid leader you may have recruited from the Circle — could be present; he speaks in a raspy, menacing voice and has been pressing you toward a purge of enemies. Aradin’s line ("Thought you was busy with the foulbloods in Halsin's grove") implies he’s surprised to see someone he expected to be off dealing with another threat (Halsin’s grove/foulbloods), so some allies or events have happened off-screen. Quest flags indicate you’ve already questioned the Circle and may have accepted the “wipe” objective, and which companions are at the scene depends on your companion-inclusion flags.
- DEN_TieflingLeader_AD_DenIntro.json: Zevlor is looking over the Grove after the Raiding Party Confrontation (or looking at Aradin if Aradin is KO)
- GOB_WolfPens_PAD_Massacre.json: This PAD happens if Halsin escapes the Goblin Camp on his own and then the player enteres the Worg Pens and sees corpses of dead goblins and worgs.
- DEN_CapturedGoblin_GuardsIdle.json: Arka and Memnos are idle in the druid grove after going to confront the captive goblin Sazza. The goblin may or may not have been killed in this prior scene. Arka remains bitter over the recent death of their friend, Kagha, while Memnos, if present, tries to shake her out of it.
- CAMP_HalsinsRevenge_CFM.json: If the player sided with the goblins and helped sack the Grove, Halsin (if still alive) will show up at a subsequent camp night seeking vengeance. There's no way to calm him - the dialogue will always end with combat against him and some animals.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Aradin: Thought you was busy with the foulbloods in Halsin's grove. (node 131)
